summary: The root وصي (w-ṣ-y) primarily means to enjoin, command, or make a will. It involves giving a charge or instruction, often with a sense of care or guardianship.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

headwords.gloss: He enjoined him; charged him; bade him; ordered him; he commanded him; to do such a thing

parts.t: He enjoined him; charged him; bade him; ordered him:

headwords.def: وَصَّاهُ and He enjoined him; charged him; bade him; ordered him: (K, &c.:) he commanded him, بِكَذَا , to do such a thing. (Msb.)

headwords.gloss: He bequeathed to him the third; He made his will

parts.t: He bequeathed to him the third

headwords.def: أَوْصَى لَهُ بِالثُّلُثِ He bequeathed to him the third of the property. (MA.) أَوْصَى He made his will. See 2.

headwords.gloss: They enjoined, charged, bade, ordered; commanded, one another
headwords.def: تَوَاصَوْا They enjoined, charged, bade, ordered, or commanded, one another. See an ex. voce تَبَاعَثُوا .

headwords.gloss: A person commissioned; a commissioned agent; an executor appointed by a will

parts.t: A person commissioned; a commissioned agent:
an executor appointed by a will.

headwords.def: وَصِىٌّ A person commissioned; a commissioned agent: (K:) an executor appointed by a will.

headwords.gloss: An injunction, a charge, bidding, order; command; an admonition, with an endeavour to persuade

parts.t: An injunction, a charge, bidding, order,
an admonition, with an endeavour to persuade:
its place may be supplied by any word in which is the meaning of

headwords.def: وَصِيَّةٌ An injunction, a charge, bidding, order, or command: (K:) an admonition, with an endeavour to persuade: and a command: its place may be supplied by any word in which is the meaning of أَمْرٌ . (Msb.) And A will, or testament. (K, * TA.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
